subject: Kickoff: MPA and deployment gating for Accelerant (rollout, canary, training)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Simon Trench <simon.trench@accelerant.ai>, operations@accelerant.ai
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: MPA and deployment gating for Accelerant (rollout, canary, training)

Hi Simon / Ops team —

Thanks again for the signature — excited to get moving. I wanted to put a compact, actionable MPA into the thread so we have the post-signature plan in one place. Below is a lightweight timeline + acceptance gates focused on the pilot/canary, migration waves, and training handoffs. Please confirm the canary cohort (listed) and whether you can provision the sandbox data access by Day +2.

High-level MAP (dates are from Close Day = Nov 23):
- Close (Day 0): Contract countersigned; SOW to be finalized and routed for signature (target: Nov 25).
- Day 1 (Nov 24): Kickoff (internal + Accelerant Ops) — alignment on scope, data access, and support contacts.
- Day 3–7: Canary pilot (single cluster, 2 client teams) — smoke tests, latency checks, basic evals. Acceptance gate: error rate <1%, latency P95 < 250ms.
- Week 2–4: Migration waves (3 waves) — 20% / 40% / 40% traffic shifts with rollback windows. Each wave requires signed runbook confirmation and a green eval pass.
- Week 2–3: Training & enablement — Train-the-Trainer Day (internal + champion team), followed by end-user sessions during Waves 2–3.
- Week 5: Final cutover and acceptance sign-off (customer PO / acceptance email).

Evaluation plan (what we'll run during canary and waves):
- Prompt set A (15 business flows) for quality regression checks.
- Latency and throughput profiling with the Redwood tracing hooks enabled.
- Token-cost sampling to validate expected unit economics vs. quoted estimates.
- Rollback test (dry-run) executed before each wave.

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm canary cohort: operations@accelerant.ai to confirm two client teams and sample datasets.
2) Confirm SOC2 evidence request cadence (if you need our SOC2 summary and auditor contact, we can share today).
3) Approve the SOW draft link in related links and flag any redlines by EOD Nov 25.

Attachments: MPA_Accelerant_v1.xlsx (contains the week-by-week checklist), SOW_Accelerant_draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll queue a 30-minute kickoff for Day 1 once I have confirmation on the canary cohort.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Kickoff: MPA and deployment gating for Accelerant (rollout, canary, training)

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick notes and asks from our side:

On Tue, Nov 23, 2026 at 9:15 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> High-level MAP (dates are from Close Day = Nov 23):

1) Canary cohort: we prefer the canary to include the Billing and Support teams (they operate the highest-volume flows). Can you confirm those two are acceptable?
2) Sandbox/data access: we should be able to provide anonymized payloads by Nov 25, but need your ingestion spec to validate formatting.
3) SOC2: yes please send the SOC2 summary and the auditor contact. Our procurement will want the artifacts before Wave 2.

Also, for acceptance gates — would Redwood be willing to run a baseline quality eval (your QA script) against our historical data prior to canary so we have an apples-to-apples baseline? That would speed sign-off.

Simon
VP, Platform Operations
Accelerant AI
simon.trench@accelerant.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:40:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MPA and deployment gating for Accelerant (rollout, canary, training)

Simon — good calls. We can do the baseline eval against your historical data (need S3 or secure transfer link). I’ve updated the acceptance gates and added a short rollback checklist in the attached MPA. Key updates below:

Updated MAP highlights (changes in bold):
- Canary cohort: Billing + Support confirmed — target start Nov 26 (Day 3).
- Baseline quality eval: Redwood to run prompt-set A + metrics on historical set by Nov 25; results shared in the eval spreadsheet.
- Data ingestion spec: Link in related_links; ingestion checklist added to MPA_Accelerant_v1.xlsx.
- Procurement artifacts: SOC2 summary and auditor contact (see related_links). Redwood will share the SOC2 package via secure binder by EOD Nov 23.
- SOW timeline: We’ll accept redlines through Nov 25; DocuSign routing scheduled Nov 26 for signatures.

Acceptance gates (concise):
- Canary green: Quality regression delta <= 3% lesion on key flows; latency P95 within target; no critical errors during 24-hour soak.
- Wave go/no-go: Operational checklist complete, rollout runbook signed, post-canary eval passed, and procurement artifacts recorded.

Next steps I’ll take today:
- Load your historical sample (please provide transfer link).
- Share SOC2 binder link to this thread.
- Draft kickoff invite for Nov 24 10:00 PT — will propose a 30-minute alignment with Eng + Ops.

— Karthik

Simon / team —

Quick note on training and enablement sequencing from Redwood’s side:
- Day 3 (Nov 26): Train-the-Trainer session (2 hours) for Billing & Support champion leads — we’ll cover core flows, debugging tips, and fallback procedures.
- Week 2: Deep-dive admin ops + tracing workshop for 1–2 SREs from Accelerant (1.5 hours).
- Weeks 2–3: End-user sessions by product vertical (4 x 60-min sessions) — we’ll split scheduling to avoid operational impact.

Action: please confirm availability windows for your champion leads; we’ll publish calendar invites after kickoff.

Vanessa Ortiz
